name: Lotus Flow Yoga
description: Calm yoga and meditation studio site with a tabbed weekly class timetable and a guided 'breathe with me' circle in the hero.
features: Pausable breathe-with-me circle with inhale, hold and exhale cues
Keyboard-friendly day tabs for the weekly class timetable
Three membership passes with a highlighted favourite
Teacher profiles, FAQ accordion and class booking form
signature: A breathing orb expands and contracts with inhale/hold/exhale labels over a slowly drifting dusk-gradient aura
